questions.q: If $\sin \theta=-\frac{24}{25}$ and $\theta$ is in the 4 th quadrant, $7 \tan \theta+25 \cos \theta$ is equal to
questions.solution: $\begin{aligned} & \text { Since, } \sin \theta=-\frac{24}{25} \\ & \therefore \text { Base } A B=\sqrt{(25)^2-(24)^2}=7 \\ & \therefore \quad \cos \theta=\frac{7}{25} \\ & \text { and } \tan \theta=-\frac{24}{7} \quad(\because \theta \in 4 \text { th quadrant }) \\ & \therefore 7 \tan \theta+25 \cos \theta=-24+7=-17\end{aligned}$

questions.q: If $\sin A+\cos B=a$ and $\sin B+\cos A=b$, then $\sin (A+B)$ is equal to
questions.solution:
On squaring and adding the given equations, we get
$+\cos ^2 A+2 \sin B \cos A=a^2+b^2\begin{aligned} & \Rightarrow \quad 2 \sin (A+B)+2=a^2+b^2 \\ & \Rightarrow \quad \sin (A+B)=\frac{a^2+b^2-2}{2}\end{aligned}$

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.q: $\cot ^2\left(\frac{\pi}{4}+\frac{\theta}{2}\right)$ is equal to
questions.solution: $\cot ^2\left(\frac{\pi}{4}+\frac{\theta}{2}\right)\begin{aligned} & =\left[\cot \left(\frac{\pi}{4}+\frac{\theta}{2}\right)\right]^2=\left[\frac{\cot \frac{\theta}{2} \cot \frac{\pi}{4}-1}{\cot \frac{\theta}{2}+\cot \frac{\pi}{4}}\right]^2 \\ & =\left[\frac{\cos \frac{\theta}{2}-\sin \frac{\theta}{2}}{\cos \frac{\theta}{2}+\sin \frac{\theta}{2}}\right]^2=\frac{1-\sin \theta}{1+\sin \theta}\end{aligned}$

questions.solution:

questions.q: $\cos \frac{\pi}{12}+\cos \frac{17 \pi}{12}+\cos \frac{11 \pi}{12}$ is equal to
questions.solution: $\cos \frac{\pi}{12}+\cos \frac{17 \pi}{12}+\cos \frac{11 \pi}{12}\begin{aligned} & =\cos \frac{\pi}{12}+\cos \left(\frac{3 \pi}{2}-\frac{\pi}{12}\right)+\cos \left(\pi-\frac{\pi}{12}\right) \\ & =\cos \frac{\pi}{12}-\cos \frac{\pi}{12}-\sin \frac{\pi}{12} \\ & =-\sin \frac{\pi}{12}=\frac{1-\sqrt{3}}{2 \sqrt{2}}\end{aligned}$

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.q: If $\sin A+\cos A=m$ and $\sin ^3 A+\cos ^3 A=n$ then
questions.solution:
We have,
$\sin A+\cos A=m$ and $\sin ^3 A+\cos ^3 A=n$
Now',
$\sin A+\cos A=m\begin{array}{ll}\Rightarrow \quad & (\sin A+\cos A)^3=m^3 \\ \Rightarrow \quad & \sin ^3 A+\cos ^3 A+3 \sin A \cos A \\ & \\ & (\sin A+\cos A)=m^3\end{array}
$\Rightarrow \quad n+3 \sin A \cos A m=m^3$  ...(i)
Again,
$\sin A+\cos A=m\Rightarrow \sin ^2 A+\cos ^2 A+2 \sin A \cos A=m^2\Rightarrow \quad \sin A \cos A=\frac{m^2-1}{2}$  ...(ii)
From Eqs. (i) and (ii), we get
$n+3 m \frac{\left(m^2-1\right)}{2}=m^3\begin{array}{ll}\Rightarrow & 2 n+3 m^3-3 m=2 m^3 \\ \Rightarrow & m^3-3 m+2 n=0\end{array}

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.q: If $\cos ^2 A+\cos ^2 C=\sin ^2 B$, then $\triangle A B C$ is
questions.solution:
Given, $\cos ^2 A+\cos ^2 C=\sin ^2 B$ Obviously it is not an equilateral triangle because $A=B=C=60^{\circ}$ does not satisfy the given condition. But $B=90^{\circ}$, then $\sin ^2 B=1$ and $\begin{aligned} \cos ^2 A+\cos ^2 C= & \cos ^2 A+\cos ^2\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-A\right) \\ = & \cos ^2 A+\sin ^2 A=1 \end{aligned}$
Hence, this satisfies the condition, so it is a right angled triangle but not necessarily isosceles triangle.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.q: If $\cos A=m \cos B$, and $\cot \frac{A+B}{2}=\lambda \tan \frac{B-A}{2}$, then $\lambda$ is
questions.solution:
We have, $\cos A=m \cos B\Rightarrow \quad \frac{\cos A}{\cos B}=\frac{m}{1}$ On applying componendo and dividendo rule, we get $\begin{aligned} & \Rightarrow \quad \frac{\cos A+\cos B}{\cos A-\cos B}=\frac{m+1}{m-1} \\ & \Rightarrow \frac{2 \cos \left(\frac{A+B}{2}\right) \cos \left(\frac{B-A}{2}\right)}{2 \sin \left(\frac{A+B}{2}\right) \sin \left(\frac{B-A}{2}\right)}=\frac{m+1}{m-1} \end{aligned}\Rightarrow \cot \left(\frac{A+B}{2}\right)=\left(\frac{m+1}{m-1}\right) \tan \left(\frac{B-A}{2}\right)$
But, $\quad \cot \frac{A+B}{2}=\lambda \tan \left(\frac{B-A}{2}\right)$ (given) $\Rightarrow \quad \lambda=\frac{m+1}{m-1}$

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.q: If $\alpha+\beta+\gamma=\pi$, then the value of $\sin ^2 \alpha+\sin ^2 \beta-\sin ^2 \gamma$ is equal to
questions.solution: $\begin{aligned} \therefore \quad & \sin ^2 \alpha+\sin (\beta-\gamma) \sin (\beta+\gamma) \\ \quad & =\sin ^2 \alpha+\sin (\pi-\alpha) \sin (\beta-\gamma) \\ \quad & =\sin \alpha[\sin \alpha+\sin (\beta-\gamma)] \\ & =\sin \alpha[\sin (\pi-(\beta+\gamma))+\sin (\beta-\gamma)] \\ & =\sin \alpha[\sin (\beta-\gamma)+\sin (\beta+\gamma)] \\ & =2 \sin \alpha \sin \beta \cos \gamma\end{aligned}$

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.q:
If in a $\triangle A B C\frac{2 \cos A}{a}+\frac{\cos B}{b}+\frac{2 \cos C}{c}=\frac{a}{b c}+\frac{b}{a c}$
then $b^2+c^2$ is equal to
questions.solution:
We have, $\frac{2 \cos A}{a}+\frac{\cos B}{b}+\frac{2 \cos C}{c}=\frac{a}{b c}+\frac{b}{a c}$ On multiplying both sides by $a b c\begin{array}{cc}
\Rightarrow & 2 b c \cos A+a c \cos B+2 a b \cos C=a^2+b^2 \\
\Rightarrow & \left(b^2+c^2-a^2\right)+\frac{\left(c^2+a^2-b^2\right)}{2} \\
& +\left(a^2+b^2-c^2\right)=a^2+b^2 \\
\Rightarrow & \left(c^2+a^2-b^2\right)=2 a^2-2 b^2 \\
\Rightarrow & b^2+c^2=a^2
\end{array}$

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.q: The value of $\sin \left(22^{\circ} 30^{\prime}\right)$ is
questions.solution:
We know,
$\begin{aligned}
\sin ^2 A & =\left(\frac{1-\cos 2 A}{2}\right) \\
\Rightarrow \quad \sin ^2\left(22^{\circ} 30^{\prime}\right) & =\frac{1-\cos 45^{\circ}}{2} \\

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.q: If $\frac{\pi}{2} \lt \theta \lt \frac{3 \pi}{2}$, then the value of $\sqrt{\frac{1-\sin \theta}{1+\sin \theta}}$ is equal to
questions.solution: $\begin{aligned} \sqrt{\frac{1-\sin \theta}{1+\sin \theta}} & =\sqrt{\frac{(1-\sin \theta)^2}{1-\sin ^2 \theta}} \\ & =\frac{1-\sin \theta}{\sqrt{\cos ^2 \theta}}=\frac{1-\sin \theta}{|\cos \theta|} \\ & =\frac{1-\sin \theta}{-\cos \theta} \quad\left(\because \frac{\pi}{2} \lt \theta \lt \frac{3 \pi}{2}\right) \\ & =-\frac{1}{\cos \theta}+\frac{\sin \theta}{\cos \theta} \\ & =-\sec \theta+\tan \theta\end{aligned}$

questions.q: The value of the expression $\sqrt{3} \operatorname{cosec} 20^{\circ}-\sec 20^{\circ}$ is equal to
questions.solution: $\begin{aligned} & \sqrt{3} \operatorname{cosec} 20^{\circ}-\sec 20^{\circ} \\ &=\tan 60^{\circ} \operatorname{cosec} 20^{\circ}-\sec 20^{\circ} \\ &=\frac{\sin 60^{\circ} \cos 20^{\circ}-\cos 60^{\circ} \sin 20^{\circ}}{\cos 60^{\circ} \sin 20^{\circ} \cos 20^{\circ}} \\ &=\frac{\sin \left(60^{\circ}-20^{\circ}\right)}{\cos 60^{\circ} \sin 20^{\circ} \cos 20^{\circ}} \\ &=\frac{\sin 40^{\circ}}{\frac{1}{2} \sin 20^{\circ} \cos 20^{\circ}} \\ &=\frac{2 \sin 20^{\circ} \cos 20^{\circ}}{\frac{1}{2} \sin 20^{\circ} \cos 20^{\circ}}=4\end{aligned}$

questions.q: If $\cos x=\frac{2 \cos y-1}{2-\cos y}$, where $x, y \in(0, \pi)$, then $\tan \frac{x}{2} \cdot \cot \frac{y}{2}$ is equal to
questions.solution: $\cos x=\frac{2 \cos y-1}{2-\cos y}\Rightarrow \frac{1-\tan ^2 \frac{x}{2}}{1+\tan ^2 \frac{x}{2}}=\frac{2\left(\frac{1-\tan ^2 \frac{y}{2}}{1+\tan ^2 \frac{y}{2}}\right)-1}{2-\left(\frac{1-\tan ^2 \frac{y}{2}}{1+\tan ^2 \frac{y}{2}}\right)}\Rightarrow \frac{1-\tan ^2 \frac{x}{2}}{1+\tan ^2 \frac{x}{2}}=\frac{2-2 \tan ^2 \frac{y}{2}-1-\tan ^2 \frac{y}{2}}{2+2 \tan ^2 \frac{y}{2}-1+\tan ^2 \frac{y}{2}}\Rightarrow \frac{1-\tan ^2 \frac{x}{2}}{1+\tan ^2 \frac{x}{2}}=\frac{1-3 \tan ^2 \frac{y}{2}}{1+3 \tan ^2 \frac{y}{2}}\Rightarrow 1+3 \tan ^2 \frac{y}{2}-\tan ^2 \frac{x}{2}-3 \tan ^2 \frac{x}{2} \tan ^2 \frac{y}{2}=1-3 \tan ^2 \frac{y}{2}+\tan ^2 \frac{x}{2}-3 \tan ^2 \frac{x}{2} \tan ^2 \frac{y}{2}\Rightarrow  6 \tan ^2 \frac{y}{2}=2 \tan ^2 \frac{x}{2}\Rightarrow  \tan \frac{x}{2} \cdot \cot \frac{y}{2}=\sqrt{3}$

questions.q: The value of $\cos \frac{2 \pi}{15} \cdot \cos \frac{4 \pi}{15} \cdot \cos \frac{8 \pi}{15} \cdot \cos \frac{16 \pi}{15}$ is equal to
questions.solution: $\cos \frac{2 \pi}{15} \cdot \cos \frac{4 \pi}{15} \cos \frac{8 \pi}{15} \cos \frac{16 \pi}{15}=\frac{1}{2 \sin \frac{2 \pi}{15}} \cdot 2 \sin \frac{2 \pi}{15} \cdot \cos \frac{2 \pi}{15} \cdot \cos \frac{4 \pi}{15} \cdot \cos \frac{8 \pi}{15}\cos \frac{16 \pi}{15}\Rightarrow \frac{1}{2 \sin \frac{2 \pi}{15}} \cdot \sin \frac{4 \pi}{15} \cdot \cos \frac{4 \pi}{15} \cdot \cos \frac{8 \pi}{15} \cdot \cos \frac{16 \pi}{15}\Rightarrow  \frac{1}{4 \sin \frac{2 \pi}{15}} \cdot \sin \frac{8 \pi}{15} \cdot \cos \frac{8 \pi}{15} \cdot \cos \frac{16 \pi}{15}=\frac{1}{8 \sin \frac{2 \pi}{15}} \cdot \sin \frac{16 \pi}{15} \cdot \cos \frac{16 \pi}{15}=\frac{1}{16 \sin \frac{2 \pi}{15}} \cdot \sin \frac{32 \pi}{15}=\frac{1}{16 \sin \frac{2 \pi}{15}} \cdot \sin \left(2 \pi+\frac{2 \pi}{15}\right)=\frac{1}{16 \sin \frac{2 \pi}{15}} \cdot \sin \frac{2 \pi}{15}=\frac{1}{16}$

questions.q: In a $\triangle A B C, \angle B=90^{\circ}$, then $\tan ^2\left(\frac{A}{2}\right)$ is
questions.solution:
In given right angled triangle, we have
$\cos A=c / b\Rightarrow \frac{1-\tan ^2 \frac{A}{2}}{1+\tan ^2 \frac{A}{2}}=c / b\Rightarrow \frac{\left(1+\tan ^2 \frac{A}{2}\right)-\left(1-\tan ^2 \frac{A}{2}\right)}{\left(1+\tan ^2 \frac{A}{2}\right)+\left(1-\tan ^2 \frac{A}{2}\right)}=\frac{(b-c)}{(b+c)}$
(by componendo and dividendo rule)
Hence, $\tan ^2 \frac{A}{2}=\frac{b-c}{b+c}$

questions.solution: $\begin{aligned} & f(x)=\frac{2 \sin 8 x \cos x-2 \sin 6 x \cos 3 x}{2 \cos 2 x \cos x-2 \sin 3 x \sin 4 x} \\ & =\frac{(\sin 9 x+\sin 7 x)-(\sin 9 x+\sin 3 x)}{(\cos 3 x+\cos x)+(\cos 7 x-\cos x)}\end{aligned}=\frac{\sin 7 x-\sin 3 x}{\cos 7 x+\cos 3 x}=\frac{2 \cos 5 x \sin 2 x}{2 \cos 2 x \cos 5 x}=\tan 2 x\therefore$ Period of $f(x)=\frac{\pi}{2}$
